arch_decisions.title: Student exam layout: stack by default, two-column only for narrow result tables
arch_decisions.detail: StudentView.vue .pane-grid is hard-coded grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr, forcing brief+answer side-by-side and overflowing the answer form. Change default to single-column (answer panel below brief). Add a computed that switches to two-column ONLY when the brief's expected-result table has <= 4 columns (narrow, >0). DML questions (no expected table) stay stacked. Use scoped styles in StudentView.vue; do NOT touch global style.css.

arch_decisions.title: Lecturer inline preview of exam description + images
arch_decisions.detail: ExamQuestionsPanel.vue only has a plain textarea for the introduction and a separate IntroImagesEditor (props: scope:'exam', ownerId:number). Add an inline 'Preview' toggle button revealing a panel that renders the current introduction text (white-space: pre-wrap, plain text, NEVER v-html) plus the uploaded intro images the way the student sees them. Read images via listExamIntroImages(props.exam.id) from services/schemaImages.ts.

arch_decisions.title: Specific, truthful image-upload error messages
arch_decisions.detail: Backend UploadExamIntroImage (lecturer_controller.go ~709) returns 413 for BOTH per-file (>5MB) and aggregate (>25MB), and a generic 415 for bad magic bytes. Frontend schemaImages.ts hardcodes status 413 -> Error('too large') and 415 -> Error('unsupported format'); IntroImagesEditor.mapUploadError turns 'too large' into 'Aggregate intro-image size exceeds 25 MB' which is WRONG for a single oversized file. Backend: emit distinct, specific messages (per-file too large with the 5MB limit; aggregate too large with 25MB; unsupported/corrupted naming what was detected; empty/truncated). Frontend: stop overriding 413/415 with hardcoded strings; surface the backend body.error verbatim (keep 401->forceLogout). Keep magic-byte validation (PNG 0x89504E47, JPEG 0xFFD8FF).

arch_decisions.title: Exam Test Run shows row preview only; SQL errors only, no correctness
arch_decisions.detail: PreviewAnswer (quiz_controller.go ~277) returns status correct/incorrect + feedback via ValidatePreview->decideStatus. ValidatePreview is SHARED with practice mode (practice_controller.go:150) so do NOT change it globally. In PreviewAnswer ONLY: if status is 'correct' or 'incorrect', replace status with neutral 'preview' and blank the feedback, and do not send score, so correctness can't be read in devtools. Keep status 'syntax_error' + its feedback. Frontend StudentView.vue test-run panel: render the ResultTable + truncation note always; show the SQL error text ONLY when status==='syntax_error'; never show a pass/fail badge or correctness feedback for the test run.

arch_decisions.title: Lecturer per-question Avg Score = best-per-student
arch_decisions.detail: LecturerResults.vue drillQuestionStats computes avgScore = sum(all attempts)/attempt_count over ALL submissions (skews toward students with many attempts). Recompute: best (max) score per distinct student_id, then average those per-student bests. Reads raw submissions from ListSubmissions, so it is independent of ARCH-006.

arch_decisions.title: Exam question score = best attempt (not latest) across the backend
arch_decisions.detail: When a student submits wrong then correct, the scored value must be the BEST attempt, not the latest (which can be lower/zero). postgres_results.go uses latest-per-question in three places; change each to best-by-score (ORDER BY ... score DESC, submitted_at DESC tie-break): GetStudentExamResults (DISTINCT ON (s.question_id), pick max-score row's sql_text/validation_details), GetStudentResultsSummary (latest_submissions CTE), GetConsolidatedScores (LatestSubmissions CTE; may rename to BestSubmissions). Makes student detail, student summary, and lecturer gradebook all show best score.

todos.title: Student exam UX: stacked/2-col layout + test-run table-only
todos.done_when: .pane-grid is single-column by default with the answer panel below the brief; a computed switches to two-column only when expected_columns.length>0 && <=4; the test-run/preview panel shows only the ResultTable (+ truncation note), shows error text only when status==='syntax_error', and never shows a correctness badge or correctness feedback; vue-tsc passes.

todos.title: Lecturer description+image preview toggle + real upload errors (frontend)
todos.done_when: ExamQuestionsPanel has a Preview toggle showing intro text (pre-wrap, not v-html) + intro images as the student sees them; schemaImages.ts no longer overrides 413/415 with hardcoded strings and surfaces backend body.error verbatim (401 still forceLogout); IntroImagesEditor.mapUploadError passes the server message through; vue-tsc passes.

todos.title: Lecturer per-question Avg Score = best-per-student
todos.done_when: drillQuestionStats avgScore = average over distinct students of each student's MAX score; attempts count unchanged; vue-tsc passes.

todos.title: Backend: neutralize test-run correctness, precise upload errors, best-by-score scoring
todos.done_when: PreviewAnswer maps correct/incorrect -> status 'preview' with blank feedback and no score, keeps syntax_error+feedback; UploadExamIntroImage returns distinct specific messages for per-file too large vs aggregate vs unsupported/corrupted vs empty; postgres_results.go GetStudentExamResults, GetStudentResultsSummary, GetConsolidatedScores all order best-by-score (score DESC, submitted_at DESC); go build ./... and existing go tests pass.
